briefdescription.para: Promotes uniform 'select' operation I to 32 bit 'select' operation.

detaileddescription.para: I's base element bit width must be greater than 1 and less than or equal 16. Promotion is done by sign or zero extending operands to 32 bits, replacing I with 32 bit 'select' operation, and truncating the result of 32 bit 'select' operation back to I's original type.

briefdescription.para: Promotes uniform 'bitreverse' intrinsic I to 32 bit 'bitreverse' intrinsic.

detaileddescription.para: I's base element bit width must be greater than 1 and less than or equal 16. Promotion is done by zero extending the operand to 32 bits, replacing I with 32 bit 'bitreverse' intrinsic, shifting the result of 32 bit 'bitreverse' intrinsic to the right with zero fill (the shift amount is 32 minus I's base element bit width), and truncating the result of the shift operation back to I's original type.
